notes.title: "Quick-drop Surprise"
notes.content:
= Features & Changes = 
- Boxes are only revealed in the compendium if the player has held them in their hand.
- Compendium button is removed from default menu and is only available in the dungeon.
- Added the ability to quickly drop the incoming round of boxes by holding the [West Button].

= Bug Fixes =
- Fixed the "Red Box" tasks.

= Maybe =
- More rooms.
- More boxes.
- Other extras.

notes.title: Patch v-1.02
notes.content:
= Features & Changes = 
- Added "Box Tip" ability; learn more about the box you're holding by pressing [West Button].
- Added tutorial message to show players how to use "Box Tip" ability.
- Added "Compendium" in menu, which shows description of all special boxes.
- Shortened the time tutorial messages show before "Okay" button appears.

= Bug Fixes =
- Fixed issue with Eater box.
- Fixed issue causing the ending to be unreachable.

= Coming Soon =
- Ability to instantly drop next wave of boxes.

= Maybe =
- More rooms.
- More boxes.
- Other extras
